corrections.before: Business Users read and post **Full thread** comments on their records. They do not see **Legal only** or **Working team**. A later-added team member can read the Full Thread history. Removing membership ends that access. Legal must choose Full Thread for a message intended for the business.
corrections.after: Business Users read and post Full Thread comments on their records. In the Comments applet, a Full Thread comment shows **Contract Team** on a Contract and **Matter Team** on a Matter. Business Users do not see **Legal Only** comments or older **Internal team** comments. A later-added team member can read the earlier Contract Team or Matter Team comments. corrections.section: A shared record does not share everything
corrections.before: The History applet shows shared comments and business record changes. It excludes Legal Only and Working Team activity.
corrections.after: The Portal History applet shows Contract Team and Matter Team comment activity. It excludes Legal Only and Internal team activity. Record changes do not appear in Portal History. The record details and **Fields** show the current values.
corrections.evidence: Walkthrough r1 failure D6b.history-business-change (classified product-bug). Confirmed in source: apps/api/src/modules/portal/applets.ts /portal/activity scopes to activity_log.visibility = 'full_thread' and would accept <type>.updated rows, but every Contract and Matter record edit is written at RECORD_ACTIVITY_TIER = 'working_team' (apps/api/src/lib/activity.ts; contracts/routes.ts, contracts/create.ts, matters). No code path writes a record edit at full_thread, so Portal History never lists one. The article now describes actual behaviour because no procedure depends on it; the reader still finds current values in Overview and Fields. Product bug reported. If the bug is fixed, restore the business record changes sentence.

confirmedClaims: The three account types are Administrator, Legal Team Member and Business User; Contributor is not in USER_ROLES. Only an Administrator changes a role (PATCH /users/:userId/role).

A Confidential Contract admits an Administrator or Legal Team Member with a team row or as Legal Owner (manager_id); a Confidential Matter admits a team row or the Matter Manager. There is no Administrator bypass. A Business User needs a team row, and Portal scopes also exclude archived records.

Confidential audience changes (flag and team changes on a Confidential record) need an Administrator, the Creator, or the Legal Owner or Matter Manager, and the actor must already reach the record and be Member+. The full app disables Add team member and the remove control for others (audienceLocked).

Team applet: Add team member icon control, Person select, Add. TeamRoster shows one row per person with Legal Owner or Matter Manager, Business Owner and Creator statements. Since 6f8ae150 the remove control appears on every team member row, including people with statements, and removal keeps the statements.
Portal team add is allowed on non-Confidential records only (403 'Ask Legal to add members to a Confidential record.'). Portal has no remove control.
DELETE team row ends Business User access on the next read: every Portal read, the Request redirect and documents use the current team scope.
Business Owner changes on Overview do not insert or delete team rows. Record creation and conversion add the creator and the Business Owner (the Requester at conversion) as team rows.

A converted Request redirects to the record while the Requester can reach it; if the record is archived, the Request page shows the archived notice and the original request without a thread or attachments.

Business Users hear only Full Thread (readableTiers / PORTAL_TIERS). Portal History shows Full Thread comments and business-value changes (description, value, effective date, Department, Region, business Fields).
Confidential Documents narrow to the record's named audience (documentAudienceScope). Business Users reach no Entities (entityReachScope returns false).
limitations: Source inspection supports technical accuracy only; the independent V-C06 browser walkthrough is still required.
The migration statements about the former Contributor type and Stakeholder list were not re-traced through migrations; the article keeps them as CONTEXT.md states them.
